entity.name: Ankan Saha
entity.description: Systems engineer and open-source maintainer based in West Bengal, India. Creator of AxioDB, an embedded ACID document database for Node.js and Bun with 27,000+ annual npm downloads.

projects.name: AxioDB
projects.description: Zero-dependency, pure TypeScript embedded ACID document database for Node.js and Bun. Eliminates native C++ compilation (node-gyp) overhead while providing durability, indexing, and high-concurrency document operations for local and edge environments.

plans.name: AxioDB Engine Scaling & Concurrency Benchmarks
plans.description: 3-month milestone funding plan to support full-time open-source development: 1) In-memory B-Tree indexer for sub-millisecond query filters; 2) Automated ACID crash-recovery test suite testing process kill durability (SIGKILL resistance); 3) Zero-copy streaming JSON reader for bounded memory consumption under multi-gigabyte collections; 4) Public benchmark dashboard comparing AxioDB with LevelDB and SQLite.
